data.gender_notes: Sharvikaatha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvikaatha is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' (auspicious) and 'Katha' (story or knowledge). It is believed that the name Sharvikaatha represents the Goddess of Knowledge or the Goddess of Wisdom. The name Sharvikaatha carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sharvikaatha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharvikaatha is a spiritual name that signifies knowledge and wisdom. It is believed that the Goddess Sharvikaatha bestows the blessings of knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment upon those who seek her grace.
data.etymology: Sharvikaatha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvikaatha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
